title: Environmental Conservation
description: Protecting biodiversity, promoting organic practices, and minimizing the ecological footprint of tourism activities in sensitive ecosystems.
details: Reforestation programs in Thakurgaon and Panchagarh districts
Organic farming education for local communities
Wildlife habitat monitoring along river systems
Zero single-use plastic policy at all ESDO eco-tourism sites
Water conservation through traditional pond management

title: Community Empowerment
description: Training local communities as tourism entrepreneurs — from homestay management to guided tours — creating sustainable livelihoods.
details: Homestay training for 200+ families across 3 districts
Local guide certification program for youth
Artisan market development for traditional crafts
Revenue sharing: 70-90% of tourism income stays local
Community-led tourism planning committees

title: Cultural Preservation
description: Documenting and celebrating indigenous traditions, crafts, and heritage sites to keep cultural identity alive for future generations.
details: Oral history documentation of indigenous Santal communities
Terracotta heritage conservation at Kantaji Temple
Traditional agricultural knowledge preservation
Heritage mango cultivar protection program
Cultural storytelling training for local guides

title: Economic Growth
description: Channeling tourism revenue directly into local economies through community-based tourism enterprises and fair-trade practices.
details: Average homestay income increase: ৳6,400-15,000/month per family
Local guide employment: 50+ certified guides
Artisan product sales through eco-tourism channels
Community fund reinvestment from tourism revenue
Indirect job creation in transport, food, and services

title: Responsible Travel
description: Educating visitors on sustainable practices, waste management, and respectful engagement with local communities and ecosystems.
details: Pre-visit orientation for all eco-tourism guests
Leave-no-trace guidelines at all sites
Waste segregation and composting programs
Cultural sensitivity training for visitors
Carbon offset through tree planting programs

title: Partnership & Collaboration
description: Working with government bodies, international organizations, and local stakeholders to build a scalable eco-tourism framework.
details: Partnership with Kazi & Kazi Tea Estate for visitor programs
Government coordination on border tourism infrastructure
NGO network for community development alignment
International organization support for capacity building
Academic partnerships for research and documentation
